newsitem.title: USA: Honesty pays off for South Dakota family.
newsitem.headline: Honesty pays off for South Dakota family.

text.p: Honesty paid off for a South Dakota woman and her two children when law enforcement officials allowed them to keep more than $7,000 in cash they found while hiking last year, authorities said Friday.
A spokesman for the Pennington County Sheriff's Department said they stumbled across the money while they were hiking through South Dakota's Black Hills last December.
The family handed the money to the sheriff's office, who put it into an evidence locker, suspecting that it might have come from a drug deal or other criminal activity.
But because no one came forward to claim the cash, authorities this week gave the money back to the people who found it. Their names were not made public.
